description: List the incidents shown on one status page, newest first, both posted by a person and opened by Fettle. Each has id, title, status, is_auto (opened by Fettle from a monitor), started_at, resolved_at, notified_at (when subscribers were first emailed; null if never), component_ids and updates (the timeline, oldest first, each with id, status, body, created_by and created_at). Use it to find the incident_id for post_status_page_update. Monitor outages behind the scenes are list_incidents. Returns a page: items plus total, page, size and pages.

page_id.description: The status page's uuid from list_status_pages. An id that is not a status page of this organization is a 404.

size.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100; default 25. Keep paging until you have seen total rows.

name: list_status_page_incidents

status.description: Known values: INVESTIGATING, IDENTIFIED, MONITORING, RESOLVED.
